# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Async pixels and Vulkan support**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds async pixel readback, a new Vulkan package, and upstream Skia m151 bug fixes. This release introduces `RequestReadPixels` for backend-neutral async pixel readback on both `SKImage` and `SKSurface`, ships a new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` NuGet package, expands CI test coverage to Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server containers, and picks up the latest upstream Skia m151 engine fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream Skia m151 bug fixes merged** — Picks up the latest Chrome/m151 upstream renderer fixes, keeping the bundled engine current with the Skia release track. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Async pixel readback for SKImage and SKSurface** — New `RequestReadPixels` method provides a backend-neutral async path for reading pixels from both `SKImage` and `SKSurface`, avoiding GPU pipeline stalls on Metal, Vulkan, and other async-capable backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create failure path** — A native memory allocation made during raster `SKImage` creation was not freed when Skia rejected the image. The leaked buffer is now released correctly. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **String allocation eliminated in GetEncodedText null-terminated path** — The zero-allocation fast path for null-terminated encoded text was inadvertently allocating an intermediate string; that allocation is now avoided. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized correctly** — The uniform name-to-index map is now pre-sized to the known uniform count, eliminating rehash allocations when populating a full uniform set. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new NuGet package ships the Vulkan backend surface integration built on Silk.NET, with Vulkan test runs enabled on both Android and Linux CI legs. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Containerized test legs added: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — CI now runs SkiaSharp tests inside Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server containers, broadening platform coverage for server and container deployments. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Switches to FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, fixing the long-standing absence of font support in minimal Windows Server container images. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Solution files converted to .slnx format** — All `.sln` solution files have been replaced with the newer `.slnx` XML format, reducing merge conflicts and improving IDE compatibility. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
